mode: Ordinary InnoDB session, native markers, utf8mb4, empty sql_mode, lower_case_table_names=0 and foreign_key_checks=1.
observations: Exact qualified owning table and lifetime
Exact native constraint identities, ordered child and parent field pairs and independent outgoing and incoming pairs
Complete original and resulting physical keys
Actual diagnostics, transaction marker and affected counts
Rejection or admission of distinguishable postcondition rows under removed and retained constraints

Schema/ForeignKey/DropForeignKeys.role: The completed ordered native InnoDB ALTER TABLE removal of one or more foreign constraints and optional physical keys.
Schema/ForeignKey/DropForeignKeys.structure: An absolute checked owning relation, ordered closed actions, grammar release, effective native algorithm and lock, and the legacy IGNORE flag.
Schema/ForeignKey/DropForeignKeys.conditions: An owner-matched nonempty ordered group includes a foreign-key action. Native lifetime, repeated-label, policy, qualified ownership, and retained physical key conditions hold.
Schema/ForeignKey/DropForeignKeys.meaning: Drop all selected original foreign constraints, preserve all surviving referential sides, remove any selected indexes, or execute the legacy ignored temporary clause under the specified native policy.
Schema/ForeignKey/DropForeignKeys.sql: Emit ALTER TABLE with the checked absolute owner, exact clause order and effective locking and algorithm.

Schema/ForeignKey/ForeignKeyRemoval.role: An immutable relative persistent foreign constraint or an explicit legacy ignored action.
Schema/ForeignKey/ForeignKeyRemoval.structure: A closed semantic kind and a name present only for the resolved physical constraint.
Schema/ForeignKey/ForeignKeyRemoval.conditions: A persistent name is a decoded BMP identifier of no more than 64 characters. The legacy temporary action has no meaningful name. The root checks its native table role.
Schema/ForeignKey/ForeignKeyRemoval.meaning: Select the referenced physical constraint of the absolute enclosing owner, or perform the legacy temporary clause that leaves its constraint graph unchanged.
Schema/ForeignKey/ForeignKeyRemoval.sql: Emit DROP FOREIGN KEY with a quoted physical symbol or the empty placeholder for the legacy temporary clause.

Schema/ForeignKey/ForeignKeyRemovalKind.role: A native referential action kind relative to its checked owner.
Schema/ForeignKey/ForeignKeyRemovalKind.meaning: Distinguish physical constraint removal from execution of the legacy ignored temporary clause.
Schema/ForeignKey/ForeignKeyRemovalKind.sql: The variant determines whether quoting uses an existing constraint symbol or the canonical empty temporary placeholder.

negative: Open native graph and invalid action lists, scopes, roles or support facts
faults: Resolve and remove the other physical constraint.
Omit the selected physical index from a mixed group.
Treat a partial failed legacy copy as atomic.

evidence.P01: Resolve the original absolute table and lifetime, native FK spelling by owner, relative action kind, retained physical support and execution policy.
evidence.P02: Check closed ordered parts, ownership, name limits, repetition, role and release policy with every remaining referenced key supported.
evidence.P03: Keep the selected coordinates, actions and policy. The native catalog, source parse and support checks remain analysis or construction inputs.
evidence.P04: Compose the per-action semantics against the final remaining graph, retaining unaffected outgoing and incoming edges and preserving clause order.
evidence.P05: Audit the immutable roles, detached ordered action list and forbidden unvalidated restoration.
evidence.P06: Observe both original and rendered SQL, including constraint identities, retained physical keys, row enforcement and transaction effects.

obligations.Q01: Audit constructor and analysis routing shape plus exact invalid action, scope, policy and dependency refusals.
obligations.Q02: Reconcile analyzed and direct admissions and native refusal effects for every coordinate, seed receipts and directed boundaries.
obligations.Q03: Observe group actions in order and verify independent incoming edges survive when the owner loses its same-spelled constraint.
obligations.Q04: Compare native graph, physical keys, row enforcement, DDL transaction marker and affected count. A legacy partial refusal has its own observation law.
obligations.Q05: Bind closed types and publication rules to audited PHP, installed distribution probes and exact native replay by release.

trackedBeyondThisSlice: Adding or renaming constraints, other mixed ALTER operations, unmodeled table engines and server modes
Native constraints created by external alteration history without complete catalog declarations
trust: Accurately described external schema profiles. Direct construction supplies resolved native facts under that same external interpretation.
Native observer, release-specific independent model, immutable shape and controller digests.
Author calibration and local candidate/verifier separation do not establish repository protection.
change: Retain the complete original finite design, native observations and faults, and verify that generation support is transient at every physical removal boundary.
